text:
Olivia Chen: hi team! first day — quick access chaos. Okta says I'm active, but when I open a shared Drive link I get 'No access'. Also my 1Password seat hasn't arrived; the invite email in the welcome checklist is olivia.chen+recruiter@gmail.com (personal) instead of olivia.c@redwood.dev. Who should I ping?

Noah (IT): welcome Olivia :wave: People Ops for the 1Password resend. For Drive, can you paste the link or the exact error? Often it's an alias mismatch or the link was shared to a different address.

Olivia Chen: error page is the standard Google 403 with "Request had insufficient authentication scopes" when I click the folder link. The link preview shows shared to olivia.c@redwood.dev but my browser keeps signing into my personal gmail account. I tried incognito.

Rae (People Ops): hey Olivia  sorry about the mail mixup, recruiter form used your personal +recruiter email. I'll revoke that invite and send a 1Password seat to olivia.c@redwood.dev now. Expect it in a few minutes.

IT Support Bot: Ticket created: #INC-2301 "Olivia C - Drive permission 403 + 1Password invite wrong email". Assigned -> Noah (IT). Priority: P2.

Noah (IT): thanks Rae. Olivia, two things while we sort emails: 1) try this quick debug — open the link in an incognito window and append `?authuser=0` or `?authuser=1` to force the Google account selection; 2) do you have any aliases listed in the directory (I can check)?

Olivia Chen: tried `?authuser=1` and toggled accounts but it still redirects me to my personal google account. I don't see aliases.

Noah (IT): ok I'm checking the directory — on our side there's an alias `olivia@redwood.dev` in addition to `olivia.c@redwood.dev`. If the folder was shared to `olivia@redwood.dev` and your session is for `olivia.c@redwood.dev`, Google can behave oddly. I'll consolidate aliases and run a group sync.

Sam (Platform): adding Oncall-Directory for the sync job — if the ACLs reference the old alias we might need to re-share the folder or run ACL propagation to clear stale entries.

Oncall-Directory: acknowledged. Standby for alias consolidation confirmation from Noah; we'll run the propagation job after. ETA ~12m post-confirmation.

Rae (People Ops): 1Password invite resent to olivia.c@redwood.dev. Check Spam/Promotions and tell me if you don't see it.

Olivia Chen: got the 1Password invite and set up MFA. thanks Rae!

Noah (IT): alias consolidation complete on directory. I forced a group sync and refreshed your SSO sessions. Try the Drive link now and let me know if the 403 persists.

Olivia Chen: trying... the link opened! I can see the folder and files now :grin: Looks like consolidation fixed it. One more small thing: who do I DM for GitHub team access? I need to clone infra/ansible.

Sam (Platform): welcome Olivia :tada: DM me the repo path and your GitHub username. I'll add you to the infra team after People Ops confirms your corporate email.

Olivia Chen: will DM now. Thanks everyone for the fast help  excited to be here!

IT Support Bot: Ticket #INC-2301 updated: status "resolved" by Noah (IT). Resolution notes: alias consolidated, group sync run, 1Password seat resent by People Ops.

Noah (IT): closing the loop: added short checklist entry to the new-hire playbook — tip to try `?authuser=` param and to confirm alias on the onboarding form.

Olivia Chen: love it, thanks again!
